subject: Clarification Required — Discrepancy in Proposal SLG/2026/00420
body:
Dear Anitha Fernandes, Coastal Insurance Brokers Pvt. Ltd.,

During document review of proposal SLG/2026/00420 for Vikram Chandrashekar Rao, our verification process identified the following discrepancies between the proposal form and the supporting documents submitted:

  - Smoking Status: declared as "Non-smoker", but supporting documents indicate "Current smoker — patient reports smoking approx. 8-10 cigarettes/day, confirmed on clinical examination (nicotine staining noted, respiratory auscultation consistent with smoker's history)"
  - Previous Insurance Claims Filed: declared as "No", but supporting documents indicate "Amara Life Insurance — Health Rider Claim, 14 September 2023, ₹2,10,000, Settled (Cardiac investigation)"
  - Declared Annual Income: declared as "1800000.0", but supporting documents indicate "900000.0"

Please confirm the accurate information or provide clarifying documentation so we can proceed with the underwriting assessment. The proposal has been placed on hold pending this clarification.

Regards,
Underwriting Operations Team
Suryodaya Life & General Insurance Co. Ltd.
